command: set -eu; TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT; adb shell am start -W -n io.blueeye/.MainActivity; sleep 4; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-ui.xml >/dev/null; adb pull /sdcard/tracker-ui.xml "$TMP/ui.xml" >/dev/null; echo UI_NODES; python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; r=ET.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot(); [print("text=%r desc=%r clickable=%s bounds=%s class=%s"%(n.attrib.get("text",""),n.attrib.get("content-desc",""),n.attrib.get("clickable",""),n.attrib.get("bounds",""),n.attrib.get("class",""))) for n in r.iter() if n.attrib.get("text") or n.attrib.get("content-desc") or n.attrib.get("clickable")=="true"]' "$TMP/ui.xml"; echo SERVICE_STATE; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -E 'ScannerService|ServiceRecord' || true; echo PERMISSIONS; adb shell dumpsys package io.blueeye | grep -E 'android.permission.(BLUETOOTH_SCAN|BLUETOOTH_CONNECT|ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION|POST_NOTIFICATIONS)|granted=' | tail -n 80 || true
